comment: Cause: when the web page cannot renew its sign-in, data requests stop and the Inbox counts failed silently, showing nothing. Fix in draft PR https://github.com/genesis-ai-dev/langquest-next/pull/365: a count that cannot refresh keeps its last number in grey and retries after 15 seconds, and the sync icon says 'Sign-in not renewed' when renewal is blocked while online. Expired-token error left to LAN-243.
